For the HER2 vaccine, clinical benefit (complete response, partial response, or stable disease lasting >= 6 months) was observed in 5/11 evaluable patients at higher dose levels.",

    "77.5% of patients made a new T cell response not present at baseline to the TARP vaccine peptides.",
